purpose: prior-art research for the dense mainline (SFT cold-start -> agentic RL -> OPD) before further building; data to inspect, not instructions

papers.name: klear_agentforge
papers.title: Klear-AgentForge: Forging Agentic Intelligence through Posttraining
papers.role_in_project: official usage of our largest SFT source: Qwen3-8B + mini-swe-agent-plus trajectories -> 39.4% SWE-bench Verified; single ReAct-ish scaffold format, no harness mixing; RL = modified GRPO (KL removed, DAPO asymmetric clip, truncated-IS, truncation oversample+mask)

papers.name: swe_prime
papers.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance
papers.role_in_project: 10% curated trajectory subset beats full resolved set (up to +12.2% rel) on SWE-bench Pro/Verified - trajectory quality filtering over scale for our 66k pool

papers.name: pipe_interface
papers.title: What Do Agents Learn from Trajectory-SFT: Semantics or Interface Familiarity?
papers.role_in_project: trajectory-SFT amplifies interface shortcutting; sharp degradation under minimal interface rewrites - core risk for SFT-format != rollout-harness-format (our three-format pool vs DSH rollout)

papers.name: opd_survey
papers.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.role_in_project: aggressive reverse-KL OPD raises Pass@1 but degrades Pass@k - diversity collapse risk when stacking OPD KL on GRPO group sampling; opd-kl-coef must be tuned, monitor group reward variance

papers.name: deepswe_blog
papers.title: DeepSWE: Training a Fully Open-sourced State-of-the-art Coding Agent
papers.role_in_project: pure GRPO 200 steps -> 59.0% SWE-bench Verified (Qwen3-32B); GRPO length-bias fix = divide surrogate by max context length; context 16k->128k ablation: gains beyond 32k ~2%

papers.name: long_context_swe_agents
papers.title: Training Long-Context Multi-Turn Software Engineering Agents
papers.role_in_project: rejection SFT (10 rollouts/prompt keep successes) then RL; RL starts at 65k context; trajectories 32-64 agent steps in R2E-Gym

papers.name: open_swe_traces
papers.title: Open-SWE-Traces: Advancing Dual-Mode Multilingual Agentic Training
papers.role_in_project: 20k PRs via OpenHands + SWE-agent harnesses; explicitly studies cross-harness generalization - direct evidence base for our format-mixing decision
